facility_name: Brooklyn Cultural Center Of New York, Inc.

inspections.violation_description: Written safety plan is available with established policies and procedures for safe operation including fire safety health care plan corrective action plans staff training and emergency evacuation plan. Plan reviewed annually and updated as needed.

violations.description: Written safety plan is available with established policies and procedures for safe operation including fire safety health care plan corrective action plans staff training and emergency evacuation plan. Plan reviewed annually and updated as needed.
Written Safety Plan contains provisions for the reporting to DOHMH within 24 hours any fire for which FDNY or other federal or state responders are notified or damages facility or endangers life

inspections.violation_description: Interior temp of 68deg. F - 72deg. F maintained when outside is 55deg F or less; heating apparatus adequately guarded; gas space heaters shall Not be used unless approved by DOHMH; kerosene heaters prohibited

violations.description: Interior temp of 68deg. F - 72deg. F maintained when outside is 55deg F or less; heating apparatus adequately guarded; gas space heaters shall Not be used unless approved by DOHMH; kerosene heaters prohibited
Heating apparatus provided with protective guards. Space heater prohibited
Fire drills conducted monthly and logged. Drill log on site and available for inspection upon request of DOHMH and FDNY
Children Not immunized with approved vaccine against influenza by December 31 of each year unless exempt

Children immunized against diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, polio, MMR, varicella, HepB, pneumococcal disease and Hib. Immunization records and medical exemption records on site and available upon request
Each staff member has documentation showing they received 2 doses measles/mumps vaccine, 1 dose rubella vaccine, 2 doses varicella vaccine and 1 dose Tdap
